description: XP, levels, tiers, the XP tables, achievements, daily challenges and streaks, and the tracker's runs: each step's xp_gained, level_up and achievement_unlocked events and signals, then the saved block and the view (src/progression/gamification.ts).
comparison: exact, object key sets included (a key TypeScript leaves undefined is absent); an unknown op or step is an error, never a skip

cases.name: levels: the curve, the next threshold, the share of a level and the tier, at each edge
cases.note: Level N needs LEVEL_THRESHOLDS[N-1]; next is 0 at level 20; the share is floored thousandths; levels 1-5 Beginner, 6-10 Elementary, 11-15 Intermediate, 16-20 Advanced.

cases.name: levels: a world curve and tier labels (past the last label, the last)
levels: two labels over a long curve, the sixth level is the second label
table: the language bundle's XP per module event
table: any other bundle gets the generic table
table: no bundle is the generic table; a module config's xpRewards win and add
table: the language table follows the tuning
achievements: the sixteen, in the order they are checked
daily: each date draws a template by its hash; yesterday is the civil day before
cases.note: Ten days in a row draw the ten templates (2026-11-19 is index 0). Yesterday crosses months, years and leap days. The streak multiplier is 10 tenths plus one a day, capped at 20; the XP is rounded half up (25 at 1.9× is 48: the original's floats gave 47).

cases.name: daily: a tuned streak (two tenths a day, capped at 15)
run: a conversation's XP is the base plus five per turn past five, turns from the fluency gain
cases.note: turns = gain / 250 (thousandths), half up: 1374 is 5, 1375 is 6. With no date the day's challenge is not tracked.

cases.name: run: the small awards (new word, mastered word, grammar, pattern, listening, onboarding and assessment)
run: refusals change nothing (a bad date, an unknown award, an event the tracker does not hear)
run: crossing a level raises level_up (rewards are port-later) and the quest count is checked after the award
cases.note: At 1290 XP and 9 quests, a quest's 25 XP crosses level 9 (1300) and checks the achievements while the count is still 9; only the check after the count unlocks Quest Hero, whose 50 XP follows.

cases.name: run: an achievement met inside a level-up comes before the quest count's own
cases.note: At 1290 XP, 9 quests and 10 NPCs talked to, the quest's level-up check unlocks Social Butterfly (the quest count is still 9); Quest Hero, though earlier in the catalogue, only unlocks in the check after the count.

cases.name: run: a tuned achievement XP, and a study streak judged by the stats alone (no level crossed)
run: an achievement's XP can cross the next level, and the nested check unlocks the level achievement first
cases.note: At 2090 XP and 9 puzzles, a puzzle makes 10 and 20 XP crosses level 11: the check inside that level-up unlocks Polyglot (level 11) and then Puzzle Master, in catalogue order, each 50 XP.

cases.name: run: the bus counters (one event counts once) and their achievements
cases.note: puzzle_solved and location_discovered award XP once (Babylon awarded and counted them twice); item_collected, npc_talked and object_examined only count; enemy_defeated only checks.

cases.name: run: below the thresholds nothing unlocks
run: quest categories and XP rewards (navigation and follow_instructions both count as navigation; 0 falls back to 25)
run: the learner's stats unlock the stats achievements in catalogue order and set the study streak
cases.note: The streak is set first, then the five stats achievements are judged in catalogue order. First Words' 50 XP crosses level 5, and the check inside that level-up unlocks Streak Master (7 days), so its events come before First Words' own achievement_unlocked; then Chatterbox, Grammar Guru and Word Collector.

cases.note: 2026-11-01 asks 3 conversations (30 XP), 11-02 a target-language conversation (40), 11-03 80 % grammar (35), 11-05 2 quests (35). Streak 1, 2, 3 (×1.0, ×1.1, ×1.2), then 1 after the missed 11-04. Only the matching kind counts; a finished challenge counts nothing more.
